frame_blender: +X right, +Y forward, +Z up (origin = ground at wheelbase centre)
frame_godot: X right, Y up, -Z forward: pos = (x, z, -y), pitch about X unchanged, scale = (sx, sz, sy)

spoiler_lip.origin: centre of the footprint on the trunk lid; z=0 = lid top (ends droop 5 cm onto the crowned lid)
spoiler_lip.use: small blade on the rear edge of the boot lid

spoiler_ducktail.origin: centre of the footprint on the trunk lid; z=0 = lid top
spoiler_ducktail.use: kicked-up duck tail, wider at the tail than at the base, Paint2 insert

spoiler_wing_low.origin: centre of the footprint on the deck; z=0 = deck top (feet sink 2 cm)
spoiler_wing_low.use: GT wing on two struts (blade z 0.17..0.23); Paint2 blade, Paint end plates; extra empty `Wing` at the blade centre

spoiler_wing_high.origin: centre of the footprint on the deck; z=0 = deck top
spoiler_wing_high.use: two-element wing on swan-neck struts (blade z 0.34..0.46), tall Paint end plates; extra empty `Wing`

splitter_front.origin: centre of the plate top at the nose bottom; plate spans y -0.20..+0.13 (rear part hides under the bumper)
splitter_front.use: front lip with Paint2 edge and canards

sedan.note: under the nose, plate top flush with the bumper underside

bumper_front_sport.origin: front face centre at the shell bottom (y=0 is the FRONT face, the shell extends 0.15..0.4 behind it, z 0..0.275)
bumper_front_sport.use: shell ON the nose: slatted central intake, side intakes, fog lamps (LightHead), black chin lip

sedan.note: shell sits ON the nose, covers bumper bar + lower valance

bumper_rear_diffuser.origin: rear face of the valance at the bumper bottom (y=0; the valance is body coloured, the plate runs 0.20 behind it)
bumper_rear_diffuser.use: central 5-fin diffuser, Paint2 end strakes, red fog bar (LightTail); exhaust tips stay outboard

hood_scoop_a.origin: centre of the footprint on the hood; z=0 = hood surface (base sinks 4 cm)
hood_scoop_a.use: ramp scoop, black intake + 2 vanes on the front face, Paint2 stripe; pitch it to the hood slope

sedan.note: hood centre, pitched to the hood slope

hood_vents_b.origin: centre between the two louvre banks (x = +-0.10..0.50); z=0 = hood surface
hood_vents_b.use: two banks of 5 louvres over a black recess

sedan.note: hood centre, pitched to the hood slope

roof_scoop.origin: centre of the footprint on the roof; z=0 = roof top
roof_scoop.use: Paint2 air box with twin vaned intakes on the front face

roof_rack.origin: centre of the rack footprint on the roof; z=0 = roof top (rails z 0.05..0.075, cross bars at 0.077)
roof_rack.use: 2 rails, 3 cross bars, 4 feet (Metal / MetalDark / Trim)

roof_light_bar.origin: centre of the base on the roof; lamps face +Y
roof_light_bar.use: off-road bar: 6 lamps + 2 side lamps in LampGlow (emissive), Paint2 cap

sedan.note: front edge of the flat roof

skirt_side_sport.origin: x=0 centre line, y=0 mid-sill, z=0 = bottom of the sill; BOTH skirts in one mesh (x +-0.84..0.97, y +-1.0)
skirt_side_sport.use: blades with black lip and Paint2 stripe, tapered ends

sedan.note: between the wheel arches, bottom of the sill

exhaust_tip_single.origin: centre of the OUTLET opening; the pipe runs towards +Y (into the car) for 0.29 m
exhaust_tip_single.use: chrome flared tip, slash cut, dark inner disc, clamp + stub

sedan.note: at the sedan's Exhaust empty (right side)

exhaust_tip_dual.origin: centre line at the outlet plane; tips at x = +-0.54, pipes towards +Y
exhaust_tip_dual.use: two single tips + hidden cross pipe

exhaust_tip_quad.origin: centre line at the outlet plane; tips at x = +-0.47 and +-0.60, pipes towards +Y
exhaust_tip_quad.use: two pairs of smaller tips with brackets

underglow_strip.origin: centre of the ring on the centre line; z=0 = tube axis; ring 1.48 x 3.80 m
underglow_strip.use: NeonCyan emissive hex-tube loop (+4 black clips); change the NeonCyan emission colour for other glow colours

sedan.note: under the body, centred on the wheelbase

grille_mesh.origin: centre of the grille opening, faces +Y (y=0 = back plate, the frame protrudes 0.026)
grille_mesh.use: chrome frame + diamond lattice, drops in front of the stock grille (0.68 x 0.16)

sedan.note: in front of the stock grille

mirror_sport.origin: centre line at the mirror height; mirrors at x = +-(0.86..1.12), glass faces -Y
mirror_sport.use: PAIR in one mesh: stalk, Paint housing, Chrome glass, Paint2 fin

antenna.origin: centre of the base on the surface; the mast leans 11 deg backwards, 0.65 m tall
antenna.use: whip antenna: base, spring, 3 telescopic sections, tip

wheel_stock.use: dished plain cover, 5 black slots, chrome centre cap (OEM look)

wheel_dish.use: deep dish with chrome lip and 5 bolts

wheel_steel_basic.use: pressed steel wheel, 6 holes, hub cap

wheel_offroad.use: chunky staggered tread, tall sidewall (rim r 0.205), 5 fat spokes, beadlock bolts

wheel_lowprofile.use: 10 thin spokes, chrome lip, very thin sidewall (rim r 0.285)

wheel_mc_sport.use: motorcycle: r 0.31, width 0.17, round-section tyre, 5 spokes + brake disc on both faces

compact.note: short rear deck + steep hatch glass: lip / ducktail only; short hood (scoop OR vents)

sedan.note: reference body: every mount was checked visually on it (rear / underside close-ups incl. exhaust_tip_quad + diffuser)

sports.note: integrated tail lip at y=-1.95 (z 1.12): prefer spoiler_wing_low/high anchored on it; low flat hood

muscle.note: already has a hood bulge/scoop at y=1.26..1.56 (z up to 1.07): skip hood_scoop_a, hood_vents_b goes on the front hood

suv.note: no trunk deck: spoilers sit on the roof rear edge (y=-2.0); roof_rack scales to the long flat roof

pickup.note: no trunk deck: only lip / ducktail on the tailgate top (z 0.90); high bumper (0.37)

van.note: no real hood (windscreen starts at y=1.6): no hood parts; spoilers on the roof rear edge; high bumper
